answer: Propose a bridge-monitoring pool: each paid key encodes ledge erosion and vine roots into its own key-salted 256-GiB dependency graph for 30 epochs. Independent auditors demand 64 linked blocks from all keys at once within two seconds; validators verify roots and signed timings. If a proof is missing or false, that key forfeits pending pay. A farm can share a model and rent RAM, but one graph cannot answer another salt: each extra identity needs 256 GiB resident plus simultaneous reads for 30 epochs. Leases still reserve distinct live capacity. This is not a MinePoA rule.
